_meta.title: MySQL / MariaDB database
_meta.setup: Ideally a dedicated read-only user: CREATE USER 'claude_ro'@'%' IDENTIFIED BY '…'; GRANT SELECT, SHOW VIEW ON app.* TO 'claude_ro'@'%'; Put user and password into .env.

examples: svc db NAME "SELECT count(*) FROM users"
notes: ro: the session is read-only – a read-only database user is the real protection.
